name: ogbg-molhiv: Molecular Property Prediction
description: ogbg-molhiv is a molecular property prediction benchmark from the Open Graph Benchmark (OGB) adopted from MoleculeNet. It contains 41,127 small molecules represented as graphs where nodes are atoms and edges are chemical bonds, with the task of predicting whether a compound inhibits HIV replication using scaffold-based splits.
